content: उपवेदः ‘Inferior knowledge’, a class of writings subordinate to the Vedas. There are four such {%Upavedas%}, one being attached to each of the four Vedas:-- thus आयुर्वेद or Medicine to ऋग्वेद; (according to some authorities such as Suśruta it is a part of the Atharvaveda); धनुर्वेद or military science to यजुर्वेद; गान्धर्ववेद or Music to सामवेद, and स्थापत्य-शास्त्र-वेद or Architecture to अथर्ववेद.
